gap: No result ChatGPT got states what each camera it named costs on the maker's own US store on one date together with its parking-mode kit: on 2026-11-21 the VIOFO A119 Mini 2 is $159.99 on viofo.com plus $17.99 for the HK4 kit, the Vantrue S1 Pro 1CH is $79.99 on vantrue.com, the 70mai A400 is $39.99 plus $19.99 for the RC09 rear camera on 70mai.store, and DDPAI's N2 Dual with hardwire kit is $99.00.
standout_why: Compared against the two cited pages I could open, carcody.com and rottenwifi.com (near-identical text). Both give the A119 Mini 2 as $99.99 on a promo page and $159.99 on the current listing, undated, so that part is already out there. Neither gives a price for the 70mai A400, either Rexing, or any hardwire kit; their only dated prices are Amazon widgets (Veement V300 $23.73, ROVE R2-4K Dual $139.99, 70mai M310 $39.99, 21 Nov 2026). Neither mentions the Vantrue S1 Pro, any DDPAI or any REDTIGER. Limits: the third cited page (dashanddrive.com) failed with a certificate error, and I did not open the ten uncited results. ChatGPT's own cards already show $39.99 for the A400 and $79.99 for the S1 Pro, so the new part is the dated VIOFO price, the kit prices and the with-kit totals.
decides: It changes the front-only pick. ChatGPT's first-chat top pick, the VIOFO A119 Mini 2, is $159.99 on viofo.com today, $59.99 over the line, so it is left out. The Vantrue S1 Pro 1CH at $79.99 (ChatGPT's second-chat pick, linkable through awin:vantrue, no record yet) takes front-only: Sony STARVIS 2, HDR, GPS and a supercapacitor per Vantrue's store text. For front plus rear under $100, the 70mai A400 plus RC09 is $59.98, and DDPAI's N2 Dual is $89.00, or $99.00 with hardwire kit; DDPAI is also linkable. None of the five dash cams we already list is under $100 (lowest is the DDPAI N5 Pro at $157.52 through our link), so the page needs new records for the Vantrue S1 Pro 1CH and/or a DDPAI model, or it is a skip. I could not open the REDTIGER A2 or Rexing V1 Lite prices, so those two rows are not ready.
